RE: Xerces DOM
The real problem is that --as far as I know -- there still isn't a
universally-agreed-upon C++ binding for the DOM APIs. As a result,
different C++ DOMs may behave somewhat differently, particularly in the
area of memory management (which the DOM spec doesn't specify). That tends
to limit code interchangability.

I'd say "Try it, and if it doesn't work write your own bridge"...
